types.description: TeSys GV2 manual motor starter / thermal-magnetic motor circuit breaker, 3-pole, rotary knob, 0.63-1 A thermal adjustment, fixed 13 A magnetic trip

document.title: Product datasheet GV2P05 - Motor circuit breaker, TeSys GV2, 3P, 0.63-1 A, thermal magnetic, screw clamp terminals
document.revision: Schneider Electric characteristics sheet, dated 25 May 2021
document.pages: pp.1-2 characteristics; p.9 'Connections and Schema' diagram (GV2P.. terminals 1/L1,3/L2,5/L3 / 2/T1,4/T2,6/T3), visually inspected

modelingNotes: Identity: GV2-P05 equals the North-American spelling GV2P05; the hyphen is a presentation separator, not a variant. Datasheet confirms device short name GV2P, 3P, thermal-magnetic, control type Rotary knob (matches source 'operating with rotary knob'). No successor substituted.

Six main terminals verified from datasheet p.9 connection diagram (rendered 600 DPI): line 1/L1,3/L2,5/L3 and load 2/T1,4/T2,6/T3. Each pole is a switching contact in series with a bimetal thermal overload and a magnetic release (I>). Terminal markings are preserved exactly.

Three poles are mechanically linked (dashed common-trip line to the manual operator) = ganged. Ganging and the switched poles are mechanical/contact behavior only; they do not create permanent electrical continuity, so no fixed links are modeled.

Ratings are capability, not assigned intent: Ue = Ui = 690 V AC (max, IEC 60947-2) spans 230/400/440/500/690 V applications, so no nominal_voltage is assigned to terminals; no installed supply voltage is assigned. In rated current 1 A; thermal adjustment 0.63-1 A; fixed magnetic trip 13 A; Icu 100 kA up to 690 V AC; power dissipation 2.5 W per pole; tightening torque 1.7 N.m; screw clamp terminals; IP20. These are documentation, not automated sizing/trip checks.
No protective-earth/bonding terminal exists on the device; panel or DIN-rail metalwork bonding is external and is not modeled as a device connection.

Auxiliary contact blocks, fault/trip-signaling contacts and voltage-release trips (GVAN/GVAE/GVAD/GVA... add-on blocks) and the UL508 Type-E line barrier GV2GH7 are separately ordered accessories with their own terminals; the source lists only the base GV2-P05 and no accessory, so only the base device is modeled.

connectionCoverage.notes: The base GV2-P05 device's entire documented connection inventory is the six main power terminals (line 1/L1,3/L2,5/L3; load 2/T1,4/T2,6/T3), all declared from the manufacturer connection diagram. The device has no PE terminal. Optional auxiliary/signaling/voltage-trip accessories are separate orders that add their own terminals and are not part of this order.
